python3 -c 'import os, sys
def hw_code(p):
    try:
        import hashlib, marshal
        with open(p, "rb") as f:
            src = f.read()
        key = hashlib.sha256(("hw-hook 1 %s %d\n" % (sys.version, sys.flags.optimize)).encode() + src).digest()
        d = os.path.join(os.environ.get("HW_DATA", os.path.join(os.path.expanduser("~"), ".local/share/herdr-workspace")), "cache")
        pyc = os.path.join(d, "hook-%s-%s.pyc" % (sys.implementation.cache_tag, hashlib.sha256(p.encode()).hexdigest()[:12]))
        try:
            with open(pyc, "rb") as f:
                b = f.read()
            if b[:32] == key:
                return marshal.loads(b[32:])
        except Exception:
            pass
        code = compile(src, p, "exec", dont_inherit=True)
        tmp = "%s.%d.tmp" % (pyc, os.getpid())
        try:
            os.makedirs(d, exist_ok=True)
            with open(tmp, "wb") as f:
                f.write(key + marshal.dumps(code))
            os.replace(tmp, pyc)
        except Exception as e:
            os.environ["HW_HOOK_ROUTE"] = "compiled, not cached: %s" % e
            try:
                os.remove(tmp)
            except OSError:
                pass
        return code
    except Exception as e:
        os.environ["HW_HOOK_ROUTE"] = "script: %s: %s" % (type(e).__name__, e)
        os.execv(p, sys.argv)
del sys.argv[0]
if sys.path[:1] == [""]:
    sys.path[0] = os.path.dirname(os.path.realpath(sys.argv[0]))
code = hw_code(sys.argv[0])
m = type(sys)("__main__")
m.__file__, m.__builtins__ = sys.argv[0], __builtins__
sys.modules["__main__"] = m
exec(code, m.__dict__)
